caption: A skydiver steps out of the open door of an airplane and drops away below it.

sa.check: A skydiver stands at the open door of an airplane.
The skydiver steps out of the door.
The skydiver drops away below the plane.
The step out comes first and the drop follows.

pc.expect: Once out of the door the skydiver goes downward and falls quicker as the gap to the plane opens.
pc.fail: The skydiver rises above the plane after stepping out; or hangs level with the door; or sinks at one unchanging slow drift as if being lowered on a line.

pc.expect: The plane flies on ahead while the skydiver falls behind and below it, so the gap grows in both directions.
pc.fail: The skydiver stays beside the door while the plane flies on; or the skydiver moves out ahead of the plane; or the plane stops in the air alongside the skydiver.

pc.expect: The skydiver is carried only by the fall and the rushing air; nothing lifts or shoves the body.
pc.fail: The skydiver stops falling in mid-air and hangs; or the body shoots sideways with nothing touching it; or the skydiver climbs back up toward the door.

pc.expect: The skydiver's clothing and straps flap and stream in the rush of air.
pc.fail: The clothing hangs still as if in calm air; or it streams downward against the airflow; or it stays stiff like sheet metal.

pc.expect: One skydiver and one airplane keep their number and shape, and neither passes through the other.
pc.fail: A limb detaches or vanishes; or the skydiver passes through the fuselage; or a second figure appears from nowhere in the doorway.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The skydiver's suit, the airplane and the sky stay the same.
pc.fail: The suit changes colour during the fall; or the airplane changes shape or markings between frames; or the cloud layer jumps to a different place.

note: Freefall scene: the skydiver's body is what shows the fall. Body position, style and how the parachute is packed are not judged.
